review: No prior attempts; my own plan from block 44's clause and its simulator tick6. (a) is false as stated: (S) is a site-value exchange, so each content is blocked only by its own kind, but an exchange moves the passed content one step back along the mover's axis. A +x record passing a +y record at 100 puts +y at 000, so the six streams are coupled. This is an exact counterexample on the 3^3 torus. Exact product-state x-currents: r+(1-r+ +r-), -r-(1-r- +r+), and -r_d g_x for transverse d, summing to (1-rho)g_x. Every tilted product measure is stationary. The linearized six-stream system (char. poly lam^4(lam^2-(1-rho0/3))) makes a standing wave evolve as 2/(3-rho0) + ((1-rho0)/(3-rho0))cos(sqrt(1-rho0/3)kt): 20/27 frozen at rho0 0.3, no sound. A 64^3 simulation fits speed 0.950 and oscillating part 0.270 against 0.949 and 0.259. (b) Clauses that never change a content are swap processes (10 orbit rates under the 24 proper rotations) and keep all six content numbers, so none thermalizes (6 additive invariants vs N,P). (c) Re-drawing only opposite pairs on a bond clock, even only on the axes perpendicular to the bond, keeps the uniform measure stationary with invariants N,P only. Head-on-only or streaming-clock re-drawing unbalances 486 of 12636. Also checked with 3 records (631800 configurations). One session, claude-opus-5-5.
what: DERIVATION, independent attempt 3 of 4: Inertia without re-drawing contents: is there a clause with waves in which no record's content ever changes?. SETTING (blocks 43 and 44; open PRs titled 'ail43: the fields of the record layer arrive by diffusion' and 'ail44: records with inertia'): block 43 showed that the two fields found in the record layer settle by a random walk (a distance R costs about R^2 ticks), so a carrier of a long-range field needs a speed. BLOCK 44's CLAUSE (supplied, not adopted): a record's content is its direction of travel. (S) each record at rate 1 tries to step along its content (six-axis menu: to x + e_d; sphere menu: to x + e_k with probability max(0, s.e_k)/sqrt 3); an empty target is entered; an occupied target exchanges contents with the record (the two pass through each other); a solid site reflects it. (C) each bond at rate gamma re-draws the contents of its two records uniformly on their momentum class (six axes: an opposite pair becomes a uniformly random opposite pair, any other pair is exchanged with probability 1/2; sphere: P/2 +- r w, w uniform on the unit circle orthogonal to P = s + s', r^2 = 1 - |P|^2/4). PROVED: number of records and momentum (sum of the contents' unit vectors) are conserved by every event; the clause is covariant; the UNIFORM measure is stationary (every record has exactly one streaming preimage; the scattering kernel is symmetric), also with reflecting bodies, and NOT if blocked attempts do nothing or if head-on pairs scatter when an attempt is blocked; in product states the mass current is (1 - rho) g and the pressure is exactly rho/3, so the linearized Euler speed squared is (1 - rho)/3 (six axes) and (1 - rho)/9 (sphere); in equilibrium the mean force on a reflecting body is exactly zero. EXECUTED: standing waves oscillate at 0.467 vs 0.483 (six axes) and 0.277 vs 0.279 (sphere) at density 0.3; bodies that CAPTURE records attract each other; bodies that emit records were also measured. The simulators are probes/lib/inertial.py (both menus: tick6, tick_s, sound) and probes/lib/inertial_bodies.py (two bodies in the sphere-menu gas: usage inertial_bodies.py L rho0 radius separation Q ticks seed gamma [absorb] [single]). TASK: block 44's scattering (C) re-draws contents in an encounter, against the plain reading of the Record axiom ('a record locks exactly one admissible local possibility'). Without (C) the clause is pass-through streaming only. (a) Prove that under (S) alone the six contents are six independent totally asymmetric exclusion streams (each species is blocked only by its own species), give the exact hydrodynamic equation of each stream (density current rho_d (1 - rho_d)) and show that a standing density wave along x does not oscillate as a sound wave: compute its exact linear evolution. (b) Classify the covariant, number- and momentum-conserving nearest-neighbour encounter rules in which contents never change (records may only move or swap sites); decide whether any of them thermalizes momentum; prove the answer. (c) If none does, state the theorem: in the six-axis menu, waves need re-drawing; and say what the weakest re-drawing is (only opposite pairs? only on a bond clock?) for which the uniform measure stays stationary. check.py: exact enumeration on the 3^3 torus with two and three records.  DELIVERABLE, in your unit worktree on ai/probes: probes/work/derive/inertial-clause-without-redrawing/<your worker name>/ATTEMPT.md and check.py. ATTEMPT.md: (1) the exact statement you attempt; (2) numbered steps, each marked PROVED (argument given in full), CHECKED (a finite fact check.py verifies exactly) or ASSUMED; (3) if the route fails, the FIRST step that fails and why: a precise no-go for a route is a result; (4) what would finish it. check.py: exact arithmetic (fractions, integers, sympy) for every finite claim; it prints `SUMMARY: PROVED ...`, `SUMMARY: COUNTEREXAMPLE ...`, `SUMMARY: PARTIAL <what is new and exact>` or `SUMMARY: ROUTE FAILS AT <step>`, and a line `HIT: <the claim>` ONLY when you claim a proof, a counterexample, or a new exact partial result others can build on; a HIT is handed to a worker of another model family to referee line by line, so write for a hostile reader. Rules: definitions come from the notes on the PR branches named above (git fetch origin <branch>; git show origin/<branch>:<note>; find them with gh pr view <n> --json files,headRefName); any outside theorem you use must be re-proved at the scope you use it or listed under ASSUMED; no status words (proved theorems are promoted by the supervisor after the referee). Have your own plan BEFORE reading the prior attempts printed at claim time; then either build on a refereed partial result or take a different route. Run: python3 probes/run_probe.py <task> --worker <name> --model <model> --review "..." --extra "python3 probes/work/derive/inertial-clause-without-redrawing/<name>/check.py"
